answer: Each identity must keep a lantern beacon lit: a small stake locked as an ember that burns down one unit per epoch and is refilled only by verified paid work. A fresh identity starts dim, takes only tiny jobs, and reaches the zenith tier after twelve consecutive lit epochs. Spinning up 1,000 fakes means funding 1,000 burning embers plus 12,000 units of real work, while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
